cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Structural Engineer to join our team. The structural engineer will provide complete designs, develop construction documents and support structural projects. Projects typically include but are not limited to tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design and rigging plans. This position also requires day-to-day collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels and the ability to mentor and train where appropriate.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
· Develop complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to project completion.
· Conduct site visits and assessments as necessary.
· Develop various written documents as required by customers such as feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations and site visit assessment reports.
· Collaborate on designs and drawings with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, subcontractors, project managers and construction managers.
· Maintain effective working relationships with diverse groups, including company employees at various levels, clients, vendors, government regulators and other outside companies and individuals.
· Make educated decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures and standards that adhere to all required regulations and codes.
· Effectively communicate with AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
· Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Licensed by the State of [Location masked] as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
· 2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
· Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including but not limited to OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
· Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors and concrete pads.
· Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood and concrete materials.
· Highly articulate and able to deliver verbal and written reports.
· Must possess a valid driver's license.
· Available and able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
Preferred Requirements
· Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
· Experience with TIA 222.
· Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams and Outlook).
· Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software and RISA3D.

[Company name masked] is seeking a licensed and experienced structural engineer to own complete designs, develop construction documents, and lead structural projects. Projects typically include tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design, and rigging plans. This position also requires day-to-day collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels and the ability to mentor and train where appropriate.
cond_0197.responsibilities:
· Deliver complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to completion.
· Conduct site visits and assessments as necessary.
· Produce various written documents as required by customers such as feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations, and site visit assessment reports.
· Lead design coordination with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, subcontractors, project managers, and construction managers.
· Maintain effective working relationships with diverse groups, including company employees at various levels, clients, vendors, government regulators, and other outside companies and individuals.
· Make decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures, and standards that adhere to all required regulations and codes.
· Direct AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
· Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0197.requirements:
· Licensed by the State of [Location masked] as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
· 2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
· Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
· Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including but not limited to OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
· Experience with TIA 222.
· Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors and concrete pads.
· Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood and concrete materials.
· Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams and Outlook).
· Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software and RISA3D.
· Highly articulate and able to deliver verbal and written reports.
· Must possess a valid driver's license.
· Available and able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
cond_0197.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0197.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0235.intro: We are looking for a Senior Structural Engineer to join our team. The structural engineer will provide complete designs, develop construction documents and support structural projects. Projects typically include but are not limited to tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design and rigging plans. This position also requires day-to-day collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels and the ability to mentor and train where appropriate.
cond_0235.responsibilities:
· Develop complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to project completion.
· Conduct site visits and assessments as necessary.
· Develop various written documents as required by customers such as feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations and site visit assessment reports.
· Collaborate on designs and drawings with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, subcontractors, project managers and construction managers.
· Maintain effective working relationships with diverse groups, including company employees at various levels, clients, vendors, government regulators and other outside companies and individuals.
· Make educated decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures and standards that adhere to all required regulations and codes.
· Effectively communicate with AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
· Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0235.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Licensed by the State of [Location masked] as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
· 2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
· Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including but not limited to OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
· Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors and concrete pads.
· Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood and concrete materials.
· Highly articulate and able to deliver verbal and written reports.
· Must possess a valid driver's license.
· Available and able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
Preferred Requirements
· Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
· Experience with TIA 222.
· Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams and Outlook).
· Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software and RISA3D.

cond_0281.responsibilities:
· Develop complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to project completion.
· Conduct site visits and assessments as necessary.
· Develop various written documents as required by customers such as feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations and site visit assessment reports.
· Collaborate on designs and drawings with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, subcontractors, project managers and construction managers.
· Maintain effective working relationships with diverse groups, including company employees at various levels, clients, vendors, government regulators and other outside companies and individuals.
· Make educated decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures and standards that adhere to all required regulations and codes.
· Effectively communicate with AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
· Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0281.requirements:
· Licensed by the State of [Location masked] as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
· Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in structural design following SE licensure.
· Strong command of AutoCAD drafting procedures.
· Proven track record with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including but not limited to OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
· Deep knowledge of TIA 222.
· Substantial foundation design expertise in permafrost, rock and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors and concrete pads.
· Extensive design experience using steel, aluminum, wood and concrete materials.
· Strong command of standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams and Outlook).
· Expertise in Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software and RISA3D.
· Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear, professional reports.
· Must possess a valid driver's license.
· Available and able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
cond_0281.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

The role covers complete structural designs, construction documents, and support across structural projects. Typical projects include tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design, and rigging plans. The position also involves day-to-day coordination with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels and mentoring junior staff where appropriate.
cond_0331.responsibilities:
Develop complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to completion.
Conduct site visits and assessments as needed.
Produce written documents required by customers, including feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations, and site visit assessment reports.
Coordinate on designs and drawings with engineers, subcontractors, project managers, and construction managers.
Maintain working relationships with company employees, clients, vendors, government regulators, and other outside parties as required by project needs.
Make sound decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures, and standards in line with applicable regulations and codes.
Communicate with AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0331.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Licensed as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams, and Outlook).
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Valid driver's license.
Able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
Preferred Requirements
Experience with TIA 222.
Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock, and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors, and concrete pads.
Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood, and concrete materials.
Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software, and RISA3D.

Projects typically include tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design, and rigging plans. The role also involves regular day-to-day collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels, with opportunities to mentor and train where appropriate.
cond_0483.responsibilities:
Develop complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to completion, staying in regular contact with the team throughout.
Conduct site visits and assessments as necessary.
Develop various written documents as required by customers, such as feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations, and site visit assessment reports.
Actively collaborate on designs and drawings with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, subcontractors, project managers, and construction managers — speaking up to clarify requirements and walk the team through decisions.
Maintain ongoing working relationships with diverse groups, including company employees at various levels, clients, vendors, government regulators, and other outside companies and individuals.
Make informed decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures, and standards that adhere to all required regulations and codes.
Communicate directly and regularly with AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0483.requirements:
Licensed as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including but not limited to OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
Experience with TIA 222.
Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock, and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors, and concrete pads.
Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood, and concrete materials.
Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams, and Outlook).
Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software, and RISA3D.
Highly articulate and able to deliver verbal and written reports clearly to varied audiences.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Available and able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).

[Company name masked] is seeking a licensed and experienced structural engineer to own complete designs, develop construction documents, and lead structural projects. Projects typically include tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design, and rigging plans. This position also requires day-to-day collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels and the ability to mentor and train where appropriate.
cond_0521.responsibilities:
· Deliver complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to completion.
· Conduct site visits and assessments as necessary.
· Produce various written documents as required by customers such as feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations, and site visit assessment reports.
· Lead design coordination with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, subcontractors, project managers, and construction managers.
· Maintain effective working relationships with diverse groups, including company employees at various levels, clients, vendors, government regulators, and other outside companies and individuals.
· Make decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures, and standards that adhere to all required regulations and codes.
· Direct AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
· Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0521.requirements:
· Licensed by the State of [Location masked] as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
· 2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
· Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
· Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including but not limited to OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
· Experience with TIA 222.
· Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors and concrete pads.
· Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood and concrete materials.
· Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams and Outlook).
· Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software and RISA3D.
· Highly articulate and able to deliver verbal and written reports.
· Must possess a valid driver's license.
· Available and able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
cond_0521.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Typical projects include tower and shelter foundation design, equipment anchoring, platform and shelter design, site plan development, utility coordination, fiber route design, and rigging plans. The position also involves day-to-day coordination with a multi-disciplinary team of varying experience levels and mentoring junior staff where appropriate.
cond_0601.responsibilities:
Develop complete structural designs and construction documents from project initiation to completion.
Conduct site visits and assessments as needed.
Produce written documents required by customers, including feasibility studies, structural analysis reports with supporting calculations, and site visit assessment reports.
Coordinate on designs and drawings with engineers, subcontractors, project managers, and construction managers.
Maintain working relationships with company employees, clients, vendors, government regulators, and other outside parties as required by project needs.
Make sound decisions on engineering ethics, costs, procedures, and standards in line with applicable regulations and codes.
Communicate with AutoCAD technicians to produce drawings.
Mentor junior engineers.
cond_0601.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Licensed as a Professional Structural Engineer (SE).
2+ Years of design experience after SE licensure.
Familiar with AutoCAD drafting procedures.
Experienced with standard construction practices and national building code and design standards including OSHA, IBC, ASCE 7, NDS, and ACI 318.
Proficient with standard office software (MS Excel, MS Word, Teams, and Outlook).
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Valid driver's license.
Able to travel for site visits (up to 15% of the time).
Preferred Requirements
Experience with TIA 222.
Foundation design experience in permafrost, rock, and conventional soils using piles, rock anchors, and concrete pads.
Design experience using steel, aluminum, wood, and concrete materials.
Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Mathcad, Enercalc, Hilti or Simpson Anchor Design Software, and RISA3D.
cond_0601.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer that warmly invites women to apply. We believe passionately that employing more women is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
